content: The autonomous-task-brain skill implements a fixed 5-step closed-loop autonomous task management workflow: perceive (scan recent sessions for new/repeated/failed tasks) → retrieve (find best practices from local skills, session history, memory systems, GitHub) → decide (select action based on historical success rate, task complexity, user preferences) → execute (create/modify skills, cron jobs, scripts or delegate subtasks) → review (record results to update knowledge base for future improvements), designed to minimize user manual intervention for task planning and execution.
